# What We Do

TrueBiz verifies business identity by combining the processing of company documents, together with searches in best-in-class data sources.

# Who Has This Problem

Financial services companies onboarding business accounts often **revert to manual review because existing data sources can not provide a complete picture of the business.**

As a result, companies often rely on the business to provide supporting documentation — which is then manually reviewed. During the process they might review:

* An Articles of Incorporation to verify business identity
* A By Laws document to verify the shareholder structure
* An invoice to validate the nature of the business

The back and forth to capture the correct documents can go on for weeks. **This slows down onboarding and creates a frustrating customer experience.**

# How TrueBiz Solves KYB

TrueBiz validates the different documents required for each step of the verification process. This is combined with searches in best-in-class data sources. This range of tools enables our clients to convert more customers, with less effort.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64085&key=user_uploads/156422/f72085b1-1265-4782-8183-a68c792b9f90)

For our clients, this results in:

1. **Speed up time to activation:** we validate documents in seconds, preventing a slow back-and-forth to capture the correct paperwork. This shaves days off revenue realization.
2. **Reduce manual review:** we help identify the \~10% of cases that actually need further attention. You can redeploy the majority of your human analysts’ time and skill elsewhere.
3. **Scale:** we remove friction from the onboarding process, so you can grow faster.

Our process takes seconds – not days, so Financial Institutions can efficiently meet Know Your Business requirements and onboard new businesses faster.

launches.body:
tl;dr We let you ensure that your users are really who they claim to be. We do this by integrating with multiple vendors and exposing them all through one single platform.

Hey everyone, Rushabh & Chaitanya here. We’re a team of enthusiastic product builders. Chaitanya brings 4+ years of experience in the Trust and Safety space as a tech lead from Google, while Rushabh brings an in-depth experience in building developer focussed products through his role as a Staff Engineer at Meta. We are super excited to publicly announce the launch of AiPrise. **We officially went live with our first few customers in just under 45 days!**

### **⚠️ Problem**

Does your platform require you to know who your customers are (aka - KYC / identity verification)?

People who have hunted for KYC/KYB providers in the past are probably already thinking - “Oh ok - here goes one more KYX provider”.

_Hint: We aren’t yet another KYX provider_

True identity verification is super challenging. **No one** provider is usually sufficient to meet all your needs. Each country has different compliance requirements, each platform has a different risk appetite, and simply checking the KYC boxes is usually not enough to prevent real fraud on a platform.

On an average, a company ends up integrating with **10+ identity providers** over time. Layering multiple vendors is not just more fraud proof, but also cost effective in certain cases.

Interesting stuff we heard from other companies:

1. **Cost Optimization** Local providers tend to be cheaper for a given region, but have limited coverage. Use a local provider for requests from a certain country, if it fails - fall back to a more expensive global provider.
2. **Device Attributes:** Regular KYC checks have become too easy for fraudsters. In one case, fraudulent users gained access to legitimate IDs, but the attack was thwarted as all the requests came in with a specific screen resolution set by a bot farm.

We can go on and on about the list here, But the gist is that on an average, a company ends up writing **100+ rules** using a varied combination of APIs just to prevent account opening scams.

Think about the complexity of the decision engine over time and the resources it takes to maintain them!\
\
**💡 Solution**

Meet AiPrise: AiPrise provides companies with a single platform with pre-integrated APIs to pick and choose from and easily manage their identity stack.

You can quickly drag and drop the vendors that best suit your needs into a workflow, add conditional logic on top of it and voila! You are done!

No more talking to 10 different vendors and negotiating contracts with them. No more reading through the docs of 10 different vendors and integrating them one by one. **You only need to integrate with us once, and get access to all the APIs you need on the go!**

We already have 15+ vendors integrated on our platform - enabling not just the usual documentary checks, but also KYB and fraud detection.

![uploaded image](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=65290&key=user_uploads/991872/05cd0a28-d59c-41ed-bda5-673ef156fd3c)

**What’s more?**

1. We also provide a client-side SDK with completely customizable onboarding screens, that you can integrate with in less than a day.
2. AiPrise also comes with a set of predefined templates to get you compliance ready super quickly!
3. Don’t see the API you need? Just shoot us an email and we will work with the API provider to make it available for you.

At AiPrise, we believe that identity verification is essential to establishing trust on any platform, and that it should be available to startups and big enterprises alike. Hence - **our platform has 0 upfront costs**!

1. If you are using an existing KYC provider or are looking for one, we can help you future proof your compliance needs. Do reach out! 
2. If you have insights / experience in this space - we would love to learn from you! Please drop a comment and we will reach out to you.

Please reach out to us at [founders@aiprise.com](mailto:founders@aiprise.com) and we are happy to help set up your compliance and customer onboarding policy.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=70075&key=user_uploads/441787/52bbfc17-b327-4223-99b1-4c221a692e23)

### **The Problem ❌**

30,000+ financial firms spend a combined total of $16b+ a year on ongoing SEC compliance, and with new regulations every year, these costs are continuing to rise. At the same time, the existing solutions can hardly keep up, with most firms paying for third-party consultants, law firms, and 2-decade-old software - while still relying on endless manual work to make up the gap.

The result: upwards of $10k/year per employee spent on regulatory compliance and thousands of hours of tedious tasks at each financial firm.

### **The Solution ✨**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=70075&key=user_uploads/441787/5a1b6f89-e106-431d-b8d0-500788a169be)

 

Hadrius scans emails, slack and SMS with GPT3, flagging non-compliant language to speed up correspondence review and does similar work for marketing review and regular filings. We’ve also automated billing reviews, allocation reviews, and rollovers by integrating into investment managers’ existing compliance stack (like client CRMs and trading systems).

# **🧨 Problem: Regulated notices are tedious and high-risk.**

For claims teams, state departments of insurance typically have very clear guidelines around the specific types of notices an insurer is supposed to provide to the parties involved. These include notices like claim acknowledgment, status updates, proactive reservations of rights, and finally, either a claim denial, partial denial, or settlement letter detailing what finally is or isn’t covered.

While that may seem straightforward, many organizations fail to meet these requirements as adjustors struggle to efficiently write notices up to the required quality bar. Numerous carriers we’ve talked to and currently work with have audited their claims organizations and found that their teams spend upwards of **30% of their working hours** just handling these notices.

Why? Many times, these notices end up in a court of law where an unhappy claimant will sue the insurer, arguing that the notice was ambiguous.

# **🎉 Solution: One platform to consolidate, collaborate, and send notices.**

Kyber’s LetterGen helps companies streamline their notice creation process, removing tedious overhead and minimizing risk from claimants suing companies for acting in bad faith.

**9:30AM Monday, San Francisco.**

Anna, the data scientist at Oak Ventures, needs to understand this YC batch to help GPs make investment decisions in YC W24.

**Incomplete data warehouse solutions:** the data warehouse solutions today - Snowflake, Redshift, Databricks, are made specifically for structured data - numbers, text enums, booleans, JSON, but not for images, documents, videos, audio and many more!

### <https://youtu.be/MvOLCnl-WHg>
\
**The Problem**

At most financial services companies, a simple marketing campaign can get stuck in legal and compliance review for weeks.

People send drafts over email, argue over disclosures in spreadsheets, lose context, and miss the market window.

With Luthor, teams upload content and instantly get:

* Checks against federal, state and international regulations
* Company policies and brand guidelines
* The right disclosures
* Suggestions based on past approvals and firm-specific rules

* Financial Services (RIAs/Broker Dealers)

* Banks/Credit unions
* Mortgage lenders
* Other regulated companies that run frequent campaigns

If you’re building in a regulated industry and deal with compliance-heavy marketing workflows, this might be relevant.

When I was on Square’s risk team, I built internal tools to manage compliance reviews.

Timing mattered. A campaign going out this week vs. next month could mean millions in volume.

But I kept seeing product launches miss their window, not because they were unsafe, but because the process was slow.

It was frustrating to watch good work get delayed by bad systems. That’s what led me to build Luthor.

We’re live with financial services firms, mortgage lenders, marketing agencies, banks, and VC firms, and are piloting with an Am Law 10 firm.

Our customers collectively represent over **$850B+ in assets under management**.

Across teams, we’re seeing review cycles shrink from weeks to hours.

# **TL;DR**

[Cardamon](https://cardamon.ai/) enables regulated financial firms to launch products, enter new markets and stay compliant 10X faster by automating regulatory mapping with AI. We cut the manual and repetitive tasks of sifting through 1000s of pages of regulation and analysing each passage - saving 100s of hours for regulated businesses. Check it out [here](https://youtu.be/EpE27zi-6JI).

**Ask:** If you’re spending time & money trying to figure out what regulations apply, send us a message at [hello@cardamon.ai](mailto:hello@cardamon.ai) - we are already helping several firms cut 100s of hours from regulatory mapping work, enabling them to launch products faster

# **The Problem ❌**

Financial firms face a host of complex regulations that make it incredibly painful to launch and maintain products in a compliant way. As a Product team at Revolut, we felt this pain deeply ourselves - we had products ready to launch but were stuck in compliance limbo, often for weeks. Turns out, getting compliant took as long as building the product itself.

Frustrated, we dug in and were shocked by how manual and inefficient the processes were. Compliance teams would have to sift through 1000s of pages of different regulations, which they would need to understand, review and transpose into product requirements, controls & policies. These processes today are almost entirely manual, taking up hundreds of hours a year per compliance employee.

# **Our** **Solution ✅**

Cardamon is an AI powered platform that ingests relevant regulation, understands what applies to each regulated financial firm, and gets compliance officers from regulation, to obligations, to product requirements in minutes - not weeks. 

Compliance officers can select any regulation they want to map to their firm. Cardamon goes through every line and evaluates:

* What is applicable
* What is an obligation 
* What the impact is
* What the associated risks types are

 

Additionally, there is the option to generate controls for the obligations and query the underlying regulations with specific questions. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87846&key=user_uploads/2331736/d0972346-1b82-4c70-bd3a-1220e3ef8730)

launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋

We're Pavan (PK), Gunin and Nirmit – co-founders of Ritivel.

## **TL;DR**

Ritivel is an AI-native workspace for regulatory and medical writing teams at life sciences companies. Our AI agents draft CTDs, CSRs, INDs, and BLAs in minutes instead of weeks, helping drugs reach patients faster.

**Ask:** Can you introduce us to regulatory affairs leaders or CISOs at pharma companies? Contact us at [pavan@ritivel.com](mailto:pavan@ritivel.com)

<https://youtu.be/VrqJtPDy_do>

## **❌ The Problem**

Every month a drug is delayed from reaching the market costs pharma companies \~$45M in lost revenue and more importantly, delays treatment for thousands of patients who need it.

Yet regulatory teams are stuck in a painful, months-long process to create FDA submissions like CTDs, CSRs, INDs, and BLAs:

**1. Information overload** 📚 These submissions require synthesizing thousands of pages of clinical data, prior submissions, and regulatory guidance which is an overwhelming task even for experienced teams.

**2. Document hunting & version chaos** 🔄 Teams waste hours digging through SharePoint folders, juggling multiple document versions, and chasing colleagues for the right files.

**3. Endless follow-ups** 📧 Regulatory leads spend their days sending reminder emails, tracking down missing inputs, and managing status updates across teams.

**4. Manual drafting bottlenecks** ⏳ Even with all the information gathered, the first draft alone takes weeks of painstaking work by highly specialized (and expensive) regulatory writers.

---

## **🔧 Our Solution**

Ritivel deploys AI agents that transform how regulatory teams work:

**Draft the most common document types like CTDs, CSRs, INDs, and BLAs in minutes** ✍️ Our agents generate comprehensive first drafts directly in Microsoft Word, following FDA formatting requirements and pulling from your existing clinical data and prior submissions. Every data point includes citations linked back to the original source, so reviewers can verify with one click.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97327&key=user_uploads/939300/4d8b39f8-8230-4dcd-b654-c51b595d124e)

**Intelligent document retrieval** 🔗 Connected to SharePoint and Veeva, our agents automatically source the right documents from across your organization: no more digging through folders or chasing down files.

**Automated follow-ups** 📧 Integrated with Outlook, our agents handle reminder emails and follow-ups automatically, so you're not stuck chasing colleagues for missing documents.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97327&key=user_uploads/939300/aa5a53c8-8d14-4c11-a20c-fecd59724cae)

**Accelerated project management** 🚀 By automating the document gathering and drafting loop, teams can focus on review and refinement rather than administrative overhead.

\
**👬 The Team**

We're engineers who previously built AI copilots at Microsoft Research. We saw firsthand that we could create better, more specialized copilots for complex workflows.

We started by selling a generic copilot to process-heavy industries like life sciences to understand their regulatory workflows. After 50+ conversations with pharma professionals, we discovered the critical bottleneck in regulatory submissions and built Ritivel to solve it.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97327&key=user_uploads/939300/3447cd20-7180-467d-919f-e6ddb5839d7a)

* **Know someone in pharma regulatory affairs?** We'd love an intro to regulatory affairs leaders or CISOs at pharma companies → [founders@ritivel.com](mailto:founders@ritivel.com)
* **Work at a life sciences company?** Try Ritivel and see the difference →[ ](https://www.ritivel.com/)[www.ritivel.com](http://www.ritivel.com)

**TL;DR:** Compliance teams at institutional trading firms still spend hours manually sifting through mountains of data across recorded calls, chats, and trade records to investigate activity and produce defensible audit trails. Determining what matters requires not only finding the right data, but also interpreting activity against applicable regulations and the firm’s own policies and procedures. TovenAI is building a platform of AI agents that connects to their systems, assembles the evidence, and surfaces what matters for compliance teams at these firms—think the sales and trading businesses at banks like Bank of America and specialist brokerages like Marex.

We are live at one of the top 10 institutional trading firms in the U.S., with multiple AI agents delivering value through our platform.

<https://youtu.be/02IMKFk38IU>

## **What we built**

TovenAI’s agents analyze activity across existing communications and trading systems using each firm’s policies, procedures, and applicable regulations as context, assembling the relevant evidence for compliance teams.

Our trade-reconstruction agent rebuilds the full sequence of a trade, links every event to its source evidence, and reduces the process from around four hours to minutes. Our electronic-communications surveillance agent reduces the false-positive burden by 3× and, in a head-to-head evaluation, delivered roughly 7× more value per alert reviewed than the market-leading incumbent.

Our platform supports several other compliance workflows, giving teams broader coverage with less manual work.

With prebuilt integrations to more than 30 systems – including Bloomberg, Cloud9, CME and NICE Actimize – firms can evaluate TovenAI on their own data in under a week without replacing their existing stack.

## **Why us**

We met eight years ago at Stanford. Batu later worked as a quantitative research engineer at Citadel Global Quantitative Strategies, building AI systems for quantitative research. Sam was a machine learning engineer at Meta, working on its ads recommendation systems.

We work closely with our customers and sit besides compliance officers every day. This gives us a rapid feedback loop, lets us see their workflows firsthand, and allows us to redesign compliance operations with AI at their core.

Sam’s mother spent her 15-year career in risk and compliance and was our first sounding board as we began exploring the space.

## **Our ask**

We would love introductions to compliance leaders at firms with institutional trading businesses.

Think the sales and trading divisions of banks like **JPMorgan, Bank of America, Citizens**, as well as specialist brokerages like **TP ICAP and Marex**. We are interested in firms of all sizes, from specialist brokerages to the largest global banks.

If you know a broker or trader at one of these firms, they can likely connect us with someone on their compliance team.

A one-line introduction is enough, and we will take it from there.

Email us at: [**founders@toven.ai**](mailto:founders@toven.ai)

Learn more about us at <https://toven.ai>.
